The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17487e3a2720b36f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 52-53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For each fixed sufficiently large n there is a finite number dn ≥ 0 with the following properties. The jump tails satisfy sup E h d>D n,N (x) | offset i ≤ ωn(D), ωn(D) −→ 0, (8.13) uniformly in the site, sufficiently large tori, prescribed masks, and 0 ≤ τ ≤ 1. For a deterministic site x, with expectation including the uniform offset, Edn,N (x) −→ dn (N −→ ∞, τ −→ 0), (8.14) uniformly in the prescriptions. If A is a growing square, whose position may be chosen from the offset and external independent randomness, then 1 |A| X x∈A dn,N (x) −→ dn in mean and in probability. (8.15) 52 The estimates for this convergence are uniform conditional on the offset, over such square positions and prescriptions, as the square side and the torus size grow and τ → 0. Bounded-length jumps capture these spatial averages to any given tolerance with arbitrarily high probability if the jump cutoff is chosen first and sufficiently large.
